548: 			JCStatement assign = maker.Exec(maker.Assign(fieldInThis, rhs));

561: 			if (hasNonNullAnnotations(bfd.originalFieldNode)) {

578: 		wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);

757: 	private JCExpressionStatement createSetterCallWithInstanceValue(BuilderFieldData bfd, SuperBuilderJob job, String setterPrefix) {
758: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
759: 		JCExpression[] tgt = new JCExpression[bfd.singularData == null ? 1 : 2];
760: 		if (bfd.obtainVia == null || !bfd.obtainVia.field().isEmpty()) {
761: 			for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
762: 				tgt[i] = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), bfd.obtainVia == null ? bfd.rawName : job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.field()));
763: 			}
764: 		} else {
765: 			if (bfd.obtainVia.isStatic()) {
766: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
767: 					JCExpression typeRef = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
768: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(typeRef, job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
769: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME))));
770: 				}
771: 			} else {
772: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
773: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
774: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>nil());
775: 				}
776: 			}
777: 		}
778: 		
779: 		JCExpression arg;
780: 		if (bfd.singularData == null) {
781: 			arg = tgt[0];
782: 		} else {
783: 			JCExpression eqNull = maker.Binary(CTC_EQUAL, tgt[0], maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
784: 			JCExpression emptyCollection = bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().getEmptyExpression(bfd.singularData.getTargetFqn(), maker, bfd.singularData, job.parentType, job.sourceNode);
785: 			arg = maker.Conditional(eqNull, emptyCollection, tgt[1]);
786: 		}
787: 		
788: 		String setterName = HandlerUtil.buildAccessorName(job.sourceNode, setterPrefix, bfd.name.toString());
789: 		JCMethodInvocation apply = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(setterName)), List.of(arg));
790: 		JCExpressionStatement exec = maker.Exec(apply);
791: 		return exec;
792: 	}

Fixed. The root cause: in `getTypeParamExpressions` (src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleSuperBuilder.java:1155), a top-level array type argument like `Integer[]` in `extends AbstractGenericsClass<Integer[]>` matched no branch of the if-chain and was silently dropped when rebuilding the superclass builder's type arguments — producing an extends clause with too few type arguments (`wrong number of type arguments; required 3`).

The fix adds a `JCArrayTypeTree` branch that clones the element type (recursively handling primitives, nested arrays, etc. via `cloneType`) and appends a reconstructed `maker.TypeArray(...)`.

Verification:
- `ant test.instance` (418 tests): `javac-SuperBuilderWithArrayTypeParam.java` now passes; the only remaining failure (`javac-BuilderNestedJavadoc.java`) also fails on the unmodified baseline, so it's pre-existing and unrelated.
- The Eclipse (ecj) handler needed no change since it copies AST type references directly instead of rebuilding them.
